column1: # NFTBan — DECLARED SECURITY-OBSERVATION STEP POPULATION  (v1.229.4 VAF-0 Stage 3B)
# ⛔ HAND-MAINTAINED. READ, NEVER GENERATED BY THE GUARD THAT VALIDATES IT.
#     DECLARED POPULATION != DISCOVERED POPULATION GENERATED BY THE SAME GUARD
#   The guard additionally DISCOVERS security-observation steps structurally and asserts set
#   parity, so unregistered growth is detected — but the expectation itself lives here.
# ⛔ TIER-AWARE. This is NOT a "Tier-A population": VAF v2 classifies gosec as TIER B, and
#   Guarding gosec's failure handling protects truthful CORROBORATING evidence; it does not
#   make gosec a Tier-A release authority. Release closure must never treat a Tier-B
#   observation as satisfying a Tier-A claim domain.
#   producer   runs the tool and emits the native artifact
#   validator  asserts the artifact/subject is usable — MUST NEVER CREATE OR REPAIR IT
#   repairer   deliberately mutates an artifact (must not manufacture one)
#   classifier turns validated observation into a verdict
#   gate       policy verdict over other steps' results

column4: Gate 1: Verify downloads match build checksums (upload integrity)
Gate 2: Verify binary integrity inside packages
Gate 3: Generate final SHA256SUMS from downloaded assets
